TechPowerUp's reviewer calls the Sapphire RX 9070 XT Nitro+ a fantastic custom design with powerful cooling and whisper-quiet fans. They found the RX 9070 XT's FPS competitive with similarly priced NVIDIA cards in both raster and ray tracing.

The reviewer notes the Sapphire Nitro+ is probably the only premium custom RX 9070 XT to use a 16-pin 12V-2x6 power input, neatly tucked away. It costs $730, a $130 premium over the $600 RX 9070 XT starting price.

The reviewer points out the RX 9070 XT keeps older GDDR6 memory at 20 Gbps (640 GB/s on a 256-bit bus), while the competing RTX 5070 series uses GDDR7. The card relies on its 64 MB Infinity Cache and architectural changes to stay competitive.
